name: Proxmox_VE_Node_Certificates
description: TLS certificate expiry for every certificate on this Proxmox VE node, asked of the node itself.
technicalNotes:
BatchScript, one /nodes/{node}/certificates/info call to this node per interval. The node is asked directly, at this resource's own hostname, and never through another node: another node would answer for itself.

Proxmox reports up to three certificates -- the cluster CA (pve-root-ca.pem), the internal cluster certificate (pve-ssl.pem), and the certificate a browser or API client actually sees (pveproxy-ssl.pem). They expire independently, so each is a separate instance: knowing which certificate is about to expire is most of the value. The endpoint needs no special privilege beyond authentication.

A node that does not answer fails the run; instances discovered previously survive, because deleteInactiveInstances is false.

Each node is scoped to its own try in both discovery and collection: one unreachable node must not cost the remaining nodes their certificates.

Days remaining is computed against the Collector's clock, because the API returns notafter as a UNIX epoch and provides no server-side 'days remaining'. A Collector with a badly wrong clock will therefore report badly wrong expiry.

Applies on ProxmoxVE_Node resources the NetScan has not marked unreachable (pve.netscan.reachable). The suite has no addCategory_* PropertySource: the NetScan sets the categories and pve.cluster.role, and the product page lists them for a resource added by hand.

datapoints.name: DaysUntilExpiry
datapoints.description: Days until the certificate's notAfter timestamp. Negative once expired.
datapoints.alertBody: The TLS certificate ##INSTANCE## on this Proxmox node expires in ##VALUE## days. Once it expires, API clients and the web UI will refuse to connect. Renew it, or check that ACME renewal is working.

datapoints.name: Expired
datapoints.description: 1 when the certificate has passed its notAfter timestamp.
datapoints.alertBody:
The TLS certificate ##INSTANCE## on this Proxmox node has expired. API clients and the web UI will refuse to connect until it is renewed.
